text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, right on the eve of the Arima 
Kinen, Seiun Sky's grandfather pays a 
visit to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her grandfather has a boisterous first 
meeting with Trainer. Though a whirlwind 
of a man, Seiun Sky seems to be quite fond 
of him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, during training, Special Week 
and Grass Wonder—her rivals in the 
upcoming Arima Kinen— paid a visit to 
offer their encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky tries to pry out strategies 
under the guise of banter, while Grass 
Wonder skillfully parries the attempts. 
—The momentum heading into the decisive 
battle builds day by day.
